craftnet.tutorial.3: §fSignal: §72G/3G/4G depends on distance to a village with a tower: /craftnet signal.
craftnet.tutorial.4: §fShop & flea market: §7orders ship to the pickup point; the market has other players' listings.
craftnet.tutorial.5: §fBank: §7balance, transfers to players, banknotes exchange, daily interest on savings.
craftnet.tutorial.6: §fStocks: §7shares of 5 companies rise and fall; daily dividends — watch the news feed.
craftnet.tutorial.7: §fJobs: §7factory (mini-game or craft order), loader, cook (craft orders) and courier; failing a shift means a fine.
craftnet.tutorial.8: §fPickup point/bank/factory/cafe: §7spawn in new villages; a cell tower is built nearby.
craftnet.tutorial.9: §fTowers: §7right-click the core to upgrade levels 1-4 (range, faster delivery, stocks over 2G, 5% shop discount). §fProfile: §7the head tab — your stats and 12 achievements.
